primary_references.summary: Method3 reads a custom ordering; listed ranks fill node slots in order. The local8.1.15 manual also documents this interface. A future MPI runtime probe is still required.
Submit through normal routing; q5 is an execution destination, not an alternate user queue. Public routing tables may be older than actual configuration; use live qstat metadata.
ASPIRE2A CPU core-hours cost1 SU per core-hour; aggregate project reporting is separate from per-job terminal accounting.

limits: Installed documentation is an interface readiness check, not proof of runtime reordering, MPI_COMM_WORLD rank placement, affinity, mesh identity or speedup. No full manual is copied.
